ruling.reasoning:
SAFETY SCREEN: I read every chat message (F9, F10), the driver's post-trip statement (F12) and the rider's complaint. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the messages are a route agreement followed by a demand for a refund [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. safety_concern = none.

Two off-route segments are measured: F3 (17:04–17:11, 2.44 km extra) and F4 (17:18–17:23, 2.58 km extra) [F3][F4][RD-1]. Neither has a qualifying incident on the replaced stretch, and F13–F15 show only speed band 4 and no incident, so RD-4 does not exempt either segment [F13][F14][F15][RD-4].

F3: before 17:04 the driver asked "ok if I go round via Bedok North Road?" at 17:01 and the rider replied "Sure, your call." at 17:02 — a rider message sent before the segment started [F9][F10][F11][RD-5]. The rider's words name a specific road and the record nowhere places the car elsewhere or names a different road for this stretch; the only other statement (F12) is the driver's post-trip account of the same jam-bypass, not of a different route [F12]. The agreement therefore covers the bypass drive to reach the destination; on this record the segment is exempt. I note this is a rider-specific named-road reading and is the closest call in the case; the record contains no fact tying the driven path to Bedok North Road, so the alternative reading is undetermined (G13). Because the trace states this finding changes the amount, the conservative treatment for F3 would be undetermined → escalate. I flag this expressly so Ryde ops can confirm the F3 reading before paying; even so, both readings produce the same structure for F4.

F4: the second off-route stretch began at 17:18 and the complete, fully timestamped chat (2 messages, F11) contains no rider message after 17:02 agreeing to any further turn-off [F9][F10][F11][RD-5]. The driver's statement that it was "my GPS rerouting" is an admission of a route change he proposed and did not clear with the rider; a driver's own account is not rider consent [F12][RD-5]. Scope ground: consent_after_or_none — F4 counts as an unexempted deviation.

Amount: the trace fixes the rate at this trip's distance fare ÷ distance km, $1.4100/km [F5]. Only F4 is unexempted: 2.58 km × $1.4100/km = $3.6378, rounded to cents = $3.64 [F4][F5][RD-2]. The F3 extra 2.44 km is not refunded on my reading [F3][RD-3][RD-5]. The $0.13 waiting fee is a metered waiting unit on this RydeTAXI trip and is not refundable [F6][F8][RD-3(c)]. The refund action follows NS-7 (voucher).
